policy.raw_interval_source: Unchanged empirical weighted PPB Cauchy envelope union both BF16 neighbors; at most nine BF16 endpoints.

scope: Two fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes use the same new MoE DLL, fixed mode0 whole-provider DLL, retained CK/FLA/CLI/AOT artifacts and original prompt/GB10 oracle. The sole environment difference enables actual down replay filtering. The certificate follows the original eight-route weighted BF16 interval through the original VT4 tree and completed shared merge; only a fixed combined BF16 endpoint permits omission, fixing the complete unrounded residual. The same-call shared event was recorded before routed work and the certificate waits on it. The bitmap is consumed by the original collector; all retained candidates use the original expert ordering and original K16 replay. Three independent counters check proposed omission, actual collector omission and executed replay. All output/actual callback IDs and first-logit tolerance0.125 are attached. Full empirical-range containment was checked against every actual selected replay in the prior same-golden observer; that is not a universal bound or a run-time check of omitted candidates. Count agreement with the prior observer is diagnostic, not the correctness authority. The single pair does not establish repeatability. No prefix, long-context, package or release acceptance follows.

static_resources.scope: Static code-object resources; not measured occupancy or kernel duration.

decision.decision: Keep the actual consumer filter default off and leave the retained stack unchanged. The complete GB10 boundary passes and actual per-call removal reproduces the independent observer, but the single pair shows no net TTFT gain. Diagnose the completed MoE critical path with the same DLL before choosing a broader producer/consumer or ownership change. Do not combine this with another timing candidate on an assumed speedup.
limits: The original empirical weighted error envelope remains conditional and is not a universal hardware proof.
A single pair does not establish a38 ms regression or repeatable performance; it provides no measured saving to retain.
All long-context, retained performance and release gates remain open.
